review_notes: Twenty-two existing recovered definitions now have structured control flow with no jumps or decompiler labels. Focused review preserves callbacks, repeated queries, live versus cached reads, native event gates and gameplay quirks. One combined incremental build; full audits, inventory regeneration, reccmp refreshes and gameplay tests deferred.

Aetherborn Marauder retains its counter snapshot and zero-safe-count dialogue path; Deaths Presence preserves contiguous stored-power reads and clears before target selection. Veteran Warleader, Brimstone Mage, Marath, Figure of Destiny, Brightling and Verdant Confluence retain mode choices, byte packing, target offsets, AI priorities and copied-mode behavior.

Exile bookkeeping retains aura scan ordering, cached next indices, legacy metadata and counter-copy calls. Mass damage preserves its two evolving turn-order passes, fallback type queries, flags and requested-damage accounting. Warp World preserves reveal/return passes and pointer advances before put-into-play callbacks.

Kira retains distinct trigger-target and top-stack scans, live versus cached target counts, marking calls and cleanup. Nyleas Presence, Oppressive Rays, Stensia and Island Sanctuary preserve casting, cost-modifier, queued-source and draw-replacement behavior. Snow Mercy retains its four tap/untap animation steps and repeated instance queries. Suspend retains owner/default-choice handling and per-upkeep work.

Targeted native inspection: ManalinkEh.dll SHA256 52793f60124a3b83d8b2728d145e918101a395b4e8d1c0af69cddcfc87ef10e5, card_relentless_dead VA 0x022a9130. On the no-black-mana/no-graveyard-shroud branch, the instruction at 0x022a91d7 reads the graveyard-position slot [ebp-0x2dc] before initialization. Preserve this native uninitialized-position quirk; do not invent an initialization or a stack-slot alias. Inspection output SHA256 6c3662bf04f17b61d2998e1047c719a00e02debfdff991daf584fdb96e90ab5f.
Readability reconstruction only; no new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
